items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: But when we got back to New York, Baby, I did it before Barney Ross.

ctx.x: Yeah. Joe Garland was the band director. He's the one that wrote 'Leap Frog,' Les Brown's theme song. He's the one that wrote that. And when he left the band, he opened up a pool room.

But when we got back to New York, Baby, I did it before Barney Ross. Kissed the Pennsylvania Station's ground, time I got there. Never no more. - One trip through the South was enough for me. You know?
You said you had private railroad cars.
